title: The old Tusset Chapel in the Bohemian Forest
description: The old Tusset Chapel on the Tussetberg in the Bohemian Forest – the model for the reconstruction in Philippsreut. Overview of the chapters on the history of the pilgrimage chapel.

blocks.alt: The old Tusset Chapel in the Bohemian Forest: a timber chapel with a pointed tower, carved decorative boards and two round windows, surrounded by forest
blocks.caption: The old Tusset Chapel on the Tussetberg

blocks.text: The chapters on the old chapel

blocks.html: The history of the pilgrimage chapel on the Tussetberg is recorded in several accounts:

items: The chapel on the Tussetberg – the chapel and Wallern · An account by Otto Veith on the mountain, earlier times, the legends, Jakob Klauser and the forest dispute
The miraculous images · An account by Otto Veith on the images of Our Lady of the Tussetberg
The Ways of the Cross, the pilgrimage days and the chapel · An account by Otto Veith
Stories of the old Tusset Chapel · by Rosl Tahedl, with recollections of the chapel’s interior and of the villages around the Tussetberg
The restoration of the old Tusset Chapel · Rebuilding from 1987 to 1990 and the consecration in August 1990
